newsitem.title: USA: Novartis blood pressure drug on US market.
newsitem.headline: Novartis blood pressure drug on US market.

text.p: Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corp, a unit of Novartis AG, said Monday it is making available daily Diovan (valsartan).
The company said the new drug is as effective as other leading antihypertensives in treating high blood pressure and has an overall incidence of side effects as low as placebos.
The company said that Diovan represents an important addition to Novartis' cardiovascular portfolio.

Diovan, said the company, is the newest entry to a novel class of antihypertensive drugs, the angiotensin II receptor blockers. It was cleared for marketing by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in December.
Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corp is part of the second largest pharmaceutical business in the world, formed on January 1, 1997 by the merger of Ciba and Sandoz.
